title: Barbarians at the gate (the lemons' head start back on, 11 cells up the lane), the radar's promise of reinforcements, and the black square over the tour (the quiet breach's reference plate)
context: Owner, 2026-10-30, the playtest of ed18be84, three of five notes: 1) "barbarians at the gate; the first wave of yellow cutis should be much closer to the rotor when we first take control, within shooting range." 4) "when Isao prints the Radar Dish, he says; with that we can call reinforcements. (This is a precursor to the Mechs arriving a few days later)" 5) "intro scene, after isao lands and while we show a full planet, there are strange black squares appearing briefly, see screenshot." (Notes 2 and 3, Isao printing the companions, are the pets-print branch's entry.)
decision: 1) STORY_FODDER.headStart back on as { hops: 11, depth: 4 } (src/content/story-defaults.js): the quiet sinkhole's fifty lemons rise as a column 11 cells up the lane toward the gate, four deep. Measured first with a probe at the Rotor's seat (story.phase piloting), each lemon's walking distance from the Rotor's cell by a BFS over the harness's neighbours: with no head start all fifty stood 14 cells out, none within the Rotor's 4.6, and the nearest was still 11 cells out twenty seconds later (the Sky model's lemons walk 1 radius a second, ~1.7 m/s); with the column, 2 to 5 cells at the seat (median 3), 38 of 50 in range at once, 48 twenty seconds later. The head start had been switched off on 2026-10-16 ("the opening's fodder out of the sinkhole") when the blobs crossed the lane in seconds; the hoppers cannot, and the note of today is the later word. 4) src/isaobriefs.js build_radar: the second line is now 'Printing the radar. With that we can call reinforcements.' (two lines, the panel's rule in test/build-programme.mjs). 5) The black square traced, not guessed: a probe screenshotting the opening every 300 ms and decoding the PNGs found the centre of the frame 95 % pure black for about a second at ~14 s into the sites tour, every run; a DOM dump at that frame showed only the game canvas at the centre (the ground feed off); a patch of three's WebGLRenderer (its render is an own property set in the constructor, so a prototype setter catches it) exposed the scene and camera, and a ray through the screen centre hit a child of the Sinkhole group before the ground: the quake's REFERENCE PLATE, the dark slab the size of the crater that heaves and fractures under the dive. From orbit, over the wireframe look, it is a black square for the second before it fractures (impactTime < 1.5). Now a breach opened quiet (obj.userData.quiet, the story's unwatched sinkhole and a sector's far breaches) triggers with tune.plate false (src/game-breaches.js) and src/sinkhole.js never shows the plate; a watched breach keeps it. On the fixed tree the probe reads no black at 14 s; the remaining dark frames are the tour's sky views.
outcome: Probes were untracked copies of the suite in scripts/ (relative imports), removed after: --seat-probe (the walking distances at the seat), --black-probe (the screenshots, a 40-line PNG decoder, the DOM dump, the GL log of canvas-bound viewport/scissor/clear calls with stack traces, the scene survey through the patched renderer). Dead ends on the way: a canvas-bound GL log first saturated on the post-processing targets' own viewports (filter on the bound framebuffer), and a prototype patch of render never fired (an own property). Tests: test/game-breaches.mjs pins the quiet plate; test/story-beats.mjs, test/build-programme.mjs green with the changes; npm test, check, architecture green.
alternatives: The lemons nearer by a faster walk: the Sky model's cap (1 radius a second) is the body's; a faster record outruns its hopper.
Open the sinkhole earlier in the tour: it already opens at the tour's start (earlyBreach 0); the lane is 14 cells and the walk ~1.7 m/s.
Dress the reference plate in the look (the floor colour and the grid): more work for a plate that is a close-up effect; it stays as it was under the dive.
Hide the plate by camera distance: a quiet breach is the one nobody is watching; the flag is already there.
evidence: Seat probe, no head start: n 50, min/med/max 14/14/14 cells, in range 0; +10 s 13/14/15, 0; +20 s 11/13/15, 0. With { hops: 11, depth: 4 }: 2/3/5, in range 38 of 50; +10 s 1/3/6, 39; +20 s 1/3/6, 48.
Black probe before: black share of the central region 0.167 at 13.4 s, 0.955 at 14.0 s (three runs); after: 0.000 at 13.9-15.2 s, the only saved frame the take-control shot's sky at 24 s (0.36).
The ray at the black frame: hit 1 a Sinkhole child, MeshStandardMaterial #1f3042, 0.519 from the camera with the ground at 0.639 (the flat raycast geometry, not the wrapped draw).
